tables.name: gold_investment_report_entity_monthly
tables.purpose: Month-end net worth by entity in USD and SGD, with the number of holdings and how many are official versus not yet official.
tables.sql: create or replace table gold_investment_report_entity_monthly as select report_month, entity, sum(net_worth_usd) as net_worth_usd, sum(net_worth_sgd) as net_worth_sgd, count(*) as holdings_count, count(*) filter (where status = 'official') as official_count, count(*) filter (where status <> 'official') as not_official_count from gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly group by report_month, entity
